⚔️ Lynel Guide
人马是全游戏最强的野外敌人，也是最好的余料来源：打法对了，白银人马就是一座会走路的武器库。
Lynels are the strongest overworld enemies in the game and the best source of Fuse materials: with the right tactics, a Silver Lynel is a walking weapons depot.

人马不像普通怪物可以莽过去：它会冲锋、跳劈、喷火、射爆裂箭，血量还厚。但它有一套固定的出招规律，学会闪避反击和骑背，普通人马也能无伤过；白银人马打下来，一根刃角就是全游戏最高的余料攻击。

You can't just bulldoze a Lynel like an ordinary monster: it charges, leaps and slams, breathes fire, and fires explosive arrows, and it has a lot of HP. But it follows a fixed move pattern — learn dodge counters and mounting, and even a standard Lynel can be beaten without damage; and a Silver Lynel's Silver Lynel Saber Horn gives the highest Fuse attack in the game.

⭐ Key Points of This Guide
白银人马血量5000，刃角余料攻击+55、碎角+51，是全游戏余料天花板。
Silver Lynel: 5000 HP, Silver Lynel Saber Horn Fuse attack +55, Silver Lynel Mace Horn +51 — the ceiling for Fuse materials in the game.
骑背攻击不消耗武器耐久：把最强武器留到骑背时用，是打人马的核心省耐久技巧。
Mounted attacks cost no weapon durability: saving your strongest weapon for mounting is the core durability-saving trick against Lynels.
地底的铠甲人马要先破甲：炸弹花、钝器重击都行，甲不破打上去几乎不掉血。
Armored Lynels in the Depths must have their armor broken first: Bomb Flowers or heavy blunt strikes both work — if the armor isn't broken, hits barely dent their HP.
人马咆哮会摧毁附近的左纳乌装置和蓝图造物，别在它面前摆炮台。
A Lynel's roar destroys nearby Zonai devices and Autobuild constructs — don't set up turrets in front of one.
对闪耀果免疫：别指望闪光弹控它，靠闪避和盾反才是正路。
Immune to Dazzlefruit: don't count on flash bombs to control it — dodging and Perfect Guarding are the right approach.

常见问题
FAQ
人马按颜色分档，越往后血量、攻击和掉落越好。游戏进程推进后，野外人马会逐步升级：前期多是普通与蓝色，中后期出现白色与白银。白银人马血量 5000，是野外单体最耐打的敌人之一，第一次打建议先备好高攻武器和回血料理再去。

Lynels are tiered by color, and later tiers have more HP, attack, and better drops. As the game progresses, overworld Lynels gradually upgrade: early on they are mostly standard and blue, while white and silver appear in the mid-to-late game. A Silver Lynel has 5000 HP, making it one of the toughest single overworld enemies — before your first fight, prepare high-attack weapons and healing meals.

与人马对峙：先读招式，再找闪避窗口（游戏实机截图）

人马的冲锋和跳劈都有明显前摇：冲锋时向侧面闪避触发林克时间，跳劈落地前向后闪避同样能触发。盾反可以弹开它的近战挥击，但爆裂箭和喷火不要硬接，拉开距离或绕到侧面。最关键的一步是骑背：人马被打晕、被箭射中头部或从高处落到它背上后，就能骑上去连砍。

A Lynel's charge and leaping slam both have clear wind-ups: side-dodge a charge to trigger a Flurry Rush, and back-dodge just before a leaping slam lands to trigger it too. Perfect Guarding can deflect its melee swings, but don't tank explosive arrows or fire breath head-on — create distance or circle to its side. The most crucial step is mounting: after a Lynel is stunned, shot in the head with an arrow, or you drop onto its back from above, you can mount it and slash repeatedly.
骑背时武器不消耗耐久，这一点要充分利用：平时用普通武器磨血、打晕，骑背的一刻再换上最高攻击的武器猛砍。骑背结束人马会把林克甩下来，落地前开滑翔伞拉开距离，再射一箭头部可以续一轮控制。

Mounted weapons cost no durability — make full use of this: use ordinary weapons to chip away HP and stun it, then switch to your highest-attack weapon the moment you mount and slash hard. When mounting ends, the Lynel will throw Link off; open your paraglider before landing to create distance, then shoot one more arrow at its head to extend control for another round.

地底有些人马穿着铠甲，直接砍上去伤害极低。正确顺序是先破甲：炸弹花贴脸炸、钝器重武器砸，甲碎了再按正常流程打。地底水上竞技场有一场五连人马车轮战，最后一只是白银人马，打之前把料理、防具和武器全部准备好，中途没有补给点。

Some Lynels in the Depths wear armor, and slashing them directly deals very little damage. The correct order is to break the armor first: Bomb Flowers detonated point-blank or heavy blunt weapons will do it, then fight normally once the armor shatters. The waterborne Depths Colosseum hosts a five-bout Lynel gauntlet, with a Silver Lynel last — prepare all your meals, armor, and weapons beforehand, as there are no resupply points midway.

三个最常见的翻车原因：第一，在人马面前摆左纳乌装置，一声咆哮就全碎了，炮台流对人马无效；第二，拿闪耀果当控制技，人马对闪耀果免疫，白白浪费素材；第三，骑背时用低攻武器，把不耗耐久的窗口浪费了。记住这三点，白银人马的难度会下降一大截。

The three most common causes of failure: first, placing Zonai devices in front of a Lynel — one roar shatters them all, so turret strategies don't work on Lynels; second, using Dazzlefruit as crowd control — Lynels are immune to Dazzlefruit, wasting materials for nothing; third, using a low-attack weapon while mounted, wasting the no-durability window. Remember these three points and Silver Lynels become much easier.
打不过白银人马怎么办？ 先去刷防具强化和料理，把武器换成高攻余料，再回来。也可以先打低档人马练闪避节奏。

What if I can't beat a Silver Lynel? Go farm armor upgrades and meals first, switch your weapon to a high-attack Fuse build, then come back. You can also fight lower-tier Lynels first to practice dodge timing.
人马角有什么用？ 余料第一梯队，也能卖钱，但留着做武器远比卖掉划算。
What are Lynel horns good for? Top-tier Fuse materials. They can also be sold, but keeping them for weapons is far more worthwhile than selling.
骑背怎么触发？ 射头部、打晕或从高处落到背上都可以，骑上去立刻换最高攻击武器。
How do I trigger mounting? Shooting its head, stunning it, or dropping onto its back from above all work — switch to your highest-attack weapon the moment you mount.
